approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (2018 Measures No. 2) Bill 2018

The opposition argued the government had delayed the fin-tech regulatory sandbox bill, which had only attracted four Australian applications compared to 146 in the UK, and criticised the lack of a gateway filter and insufficient ASIC resourcing, noting that both fin-tech groups and consumer advocates supported a gateway; the opposition will not oppose the bill but will propose amendments in the Senate.
